title: Validate a normalized palindrome
summary: Determine whether the letters and digits in text form a palindrome, ignoring punctuation and case.
requirements: Only ASCII letters A–Z and digits 0–9 count; ignore all other characters.
An empty normalized sequence is a palindrome.
Avoid creating a reversed copy of the normalized string.
hints: Consider checking characters without copying the entire normalized text.
Move two pointers inward, skipping characters that are not ASCII alphanumeric.
Compare lowercased characters before moving both pointers.

examples.label: Mixed punctuation
input: A man, a plan, a canal: Panama

tests.name: Accepts a phrase
input: A man, a plan, a canal: Panama
